thread:
ashley (oncall): PagerDuty alert -> CI pipeline failures across multiple repos; observed ~30 failing workflows in last 5m, errors look like 502/503 from GitHub Packages/npm registry. paging because we need hotfix deploys blocked.

incident-bot: Incident created: GH-ACTIONS/PKG-OUTAGE - severity: P1; assigned to ashley (oncall). Join #incidents for coordination.

ashley (oncall): Quick check: status.github.com shows partial degradation for Packages & Actions in us-east. Can someone confirm workflows started failing around 12:08 UTC?

samir (eng): Confirmed. We have failing `restore-cache` + `docker pull` steps. Logs show `GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/-/v1/search - 503 Service Unavailable` and Action runners timing out pulling our private packages.

ashley (oncall): @tj you're on SRE-next. Can you look at whether our dedicated self-hosted runners are impacted or just GH-hosted?

tj (sre): GH-hosted runners show errors during checkout & download, self-hosted runners in our k8s cluster are fine. However, many of our pipelines rely on GitHub Packages for private artifacts; the artifact pulls fail even from self-hosted runners.

lexi (product): Customer impact: Any blocked hotfixes for high-priority customers? We have a live ticket from Acme Corp needing a security patch shipped. Need ETA.

ashley (oncall): Yes, Acme has a hotfix PR approved; pipeline can't produce the release artifact. We need a mitigation plan to produce and deploy hotfix without GH Packages. Options: (1) change workflows to pull from npmjs/PyPI mirror (if packages are mirrored) (2) build artifacts locally and upload to S3 and have deploy pipeline read from S3 (3) run manual deploy via `deploy-scripts` from bastion.

samir (eng): I'll try local build + S3 upload. Quick command I'll run (pseudocode):

```
# build release tarball
./scripts/build-release.sh --tag v1.2.3-hotfix
# upload to private s3 bucket that our deploys can access
aws s3 cp dist/myapp-v1.2.3-hotfix.tar.gz s3://redwood-ci-temp/hotfixes/
# create temporary signed URL for pipeline
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-ci-temp/hotfixes/myapp-v1.2.3-hotfix.tar.gz --expires-in 3600
```

ashley (oncall): Good. @deploy-bot can we point deploy job to an `ARTIFACT_URL` env override?

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline supports `ARTIFACT_URL` override for `deploy:hotfix` job; will skip GitHub Packages artifact step if provided. Usage: `ARTIFACT_URL=https://... ./ci/run_deploy.sh`.

tj (sre): Also a couple quick safety checks: (a) ensure the S3 bucket ACL/encryption matches compliance (we have encryption-at-rest required), (b) create a short-lived IAM key for the CI runner if we need programmatic access. I'll open an approval window.

ops-bot: Request for sensitive operation: temporary IAM creds for `ci-hotfix-runner` need approval from two approvers within 30m. Approval links: <link-1>, <link-2>.

lexi (product): I'll ping legal/compliance in parallel. We need to confirm we can use S3 bypass for customer artifact.

ashley (oncall): Samir, go ahead with build & upload. TJ, coordinate the IAM approvals. I'll keep Acme updated: "we have a mitigation path; ETA ~30-45m to produce and validate a manual hotfix deploy."

samir (eng): Build succeeded. Uploaded to s3://redwood-ci-temp/hotfixes/myapp-v1.2.3-hotfix.tar.gz. Presigned URL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-ci-temp/hotfixes/myapp-v1.2.3-hotfix.tar.gz?X (expires in 1h).

ashley (oncall): TJ, approvals?

tj (sre): Approved. IAM creds issued, rotated, stored in vault. CI runner used the creds to fetch artifact in a dry-run. Dry-run deploy passed smoke checks.

samir (eng): Starting staged deploy to canary hosts using `ARTIFACT_URL` override. Command run: `ARTIFACT_URL=\"https://...\" ./ci/run_deploy.sh --targets=canary --migrate=no`.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for myapp v1.2.3-hotfix (canary pool: 10 hosts). Health checks: 0/10 failed so far.

ashley (oncall): Run a quick post-deploy validation: UI load, embed generation, and a small synthetic user flow for Acme's customer. Samir please run smoke tests.

samir (eng): Smoke tests pass for canary; no regressions detected. Rolling to 50% next.

lexi (product): Notifying Acme support: "hotfix deployed to canary, validation passed, rolling to 50% now. We'll keep you posted." :thumbsup:

ashley (oncall): Rollout to 50% complete. No errors. Starting full rollout.

deploy-bot: Full rollout complete. All checks green. Hotfix artifact source: S3 temporary presigned URL.

ashley (oncall): Ok good. Now to reduce blast radius: rotate any temporary creds, remove presigned URL exposure, and document fallback for the postmortem. TJ, can you confirm secrets rotated?

tj (sre): Temporary IAM creds rotated and revoked. S3 presigned URL invalidated by removing the object copy from the public path and re-uploading with private ACL. Vault entry for temporary key disabled.

lexi (product): Customer notified: Acme support updated and ticket marked as resolved on our side. They confirmed the functionality fix works.

ashley (oncall): Next steps: (1) Open incident on GH status: note actions and packages outage blocked pipeline; file support ticket with GitHub with our logs (I've pasted error snippets below). (2) Postmortem owner: samir + tj. (3) Create follow-up to improve runner fallbacks and artifact mirroring.

samir (eng): Pasting snippet from Action logs for ticket:

```
Error: request to https://npm.pkg.github.com/-/v1/search failed, status code 503
at fetch (node_modules/node-fetch/index.js:...)
at async installDeps (/home/runner/work/_actions/.....)
```

ashley (oncall): I'll open the ticket with GitHub, include our mitigation steps and timeline. Also note we used S3 as temporary artifact source; add runbook step for future.

incident-bot: Update: GitHub status updated -> "Investigating" for Actions & Packages. Case #GH-98765 created with GitHub SRE.

tj (sre): For the postmortem action items: automatic fallback to public npm for non-sensitive packages, pre-warm an internal artifact mirror in S3 that CI can use when GitHub Packages is degraded, and a small playbook for manual deploy flow. I'll draft RFC.

lexi (product): Also flag billing/compliance to review using S3 for customer artifacts during emergencies.

ashley (oncall): Great. Closing the immediate page: severity downgraded as customer impact mitigated. Keeping incident open until GitHub fully recovers and postmortem created.

ops-bot: Incident timeline entry created. Owner: samir + tj. Target postmortem draft in 72h.

ashley (oncall): Thanks everyone. If GitHub recovers we'll update status and wrap up. If they don't, we'll keep S3 fallback as standby.

samir (eng): Note to self: add `ARTIFACT_URL` override to hotfix runbook and test weekly.

lexi (product): Closing loop with Acme: they asked for root cause & timeline; we'll include summary in postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> transitioned to P2 (customer impact mitigated). Keep channel for postmortem coordination.

ashley (oncall): handing off to tj for postmortem work. I'm switching to oncall-off mode. tg!

tj (sre): Taking ownership for postmortem coordination. Will ping eng and product for timeline.

ashley (oncall): Thanks all. :metal:"
